item.title: 44% on ARC-AGI-1 in 67 cents
item.description:
📝 This is done from scratch at test time on both the train set and eval set puzzles (test labels hidden). This means the loss function only includes output tokens (which makes the approach supervised). I found that cranking down the momentum and/or LR drastically at this point helped, but I didn’t want to make manually changes like this.
🔗 Read more: https://mvakde.github.io/blog/44-on-arc-1/

item.title: EFF to Courts: Don't Rewrite Copyright over AI Hype
item.description:
📝 The history of technology is rife with copyright panics. Copyright owners claim that unless courts abandon 300-year-old copyright principles—and give rightsholders the power to control non-infringing works created by others—an imagined flood of AI-generated works will devastate creative markets. In other words, publishers would wield unchecked veto power over any expression that might conceivably compete with a work they own.
🔗 Read more: https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/08/eff-courts-dont-rewrite-copyright-over-ai-hype
